correctness.rationale: Conjugating the weighted Laplacian by bipartite signs produces an irreducible nonnegative signless matrix; Perron-Frobenius ensures simple maximal eigenvalue. The odd half-return equation has one scalar critical direction on the common-phase quotient. Its Taylor coefficients alpha=1+3kappa, beta=1+27kappa, gamma=1+243kappa give critical cubic -beta Q4/6 or, at beta=0, fifth-order -Q6/15. Lyapunov–Schmidt reduction gives exact branch signs and amplitude laws; the spectral gap isolates transverse multipliers, and the critical multiplier -1+2alphaLambda epsilon (generic) or -1+4alphaLambda epsilon (degenerate) determines sink vs saddle. Symbolic spot checks of the coefficients at three kappa values confirm algebra; no claim about nonsymmetric cycles.
